subject: CAIQ mapping: runtime lineage & telemetry artifact handoff for HelixBank
messages:
From: Olivia Green <olivia.green@helixbank.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Jan 2027 12:23:00 -05:00
Subject: CAIQ mapping request — runtime lineage & telemetry artifacts for HelixBank scope

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for taking this on. HelixBank is narrowing scope to our inference runtime and tenant isolation controls for the upcoming CSA review. We need a CAIQ-focused mapping that: 

- Identifies which CSA controls (v4) map to Redwood runtime components (serving runtime, KV cache, routing).
- Points to concrete telemetry/logging artifacts we can use as evidence (sample log extracts, retention notes).
- Notes any compensating controls or gap mitigations for multi-tenant paths.

Can you provide a draft mapping and a small artifact bundle we can hand to our internal auditors (CSV or XLSX + a short narrative)? Ideal due date from our side is Feb 5 to align with audit prep.

Also specify any areas that will need privileged access for evidence collection.

Appreciate it — Olivia

Olivia Green
Senior InfoSec Manager | HelixBank
security@helixbank.com

--
Attachment: (none)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Green <olivia.green@helixbank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 23 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping request — runtime lineage & telemetry artifacts for HelixBank

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear ask. Looping in Kim and Priyom (control owners for runtime telemetry and evidence collation).

Quick plan: 
1) We’ll produce a CAIQ crosswalk workbook (control -> Redwood component -> evidence artifact).  
2) Deliver a small sample bundle with: runtime-telemetry-sample.log (redacted), an XLSX mapping, and a short narrative (1 page) describing controls and where proofs live.
3) Call to review the deliverable week of Feb 1 (30–45 mins).

We aim to deliver the first draft by Feb 2 to give you a window for internal review before Feb 5. Can you confirm the auditor’s minimum acceptable artifact formats? XLSX + plaintext logs are fine on your side?

Attachments: caiq_responses_v1.xlsx (draft skeleton)

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Technical Program Manager, Trust & Safety | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com

Olivia / team — following up with an initial mapping pass. Below is an excerpt (will push full workbook to the Drive link):

CSA Control: IA-3 (Identity & Access) -> Redwood component: Private deployment + KMS integration
Evidence: KMS rotation logs (rotation-events-2026Q4.csv), doc: kms-rotation-policy.md (signed), tenant-segregation-runbook.pdf

- Prepare an evidence index CSV matching CAIQ question IDs to file names.

Olivia — can your auditor accept redacted logs + an index mapping? If they need raw exports we’ll need a temporary access window.

Attachments included: runtime-telemetry-sample.log (redacted 300 lines)

Best,
